content: embla-carousel-autoplay options: delay, jump, playOnInit, stopOnFocusIn, stopOnInteraction, stopOnMouseEnter, stopOnLastSnap, rootNode. Methods: play(), stop(), reset(), isPlaying(). The plugin does NOT automatically respect prefers-reduced-motion -- must be implemented manually (e.g. check matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') before constructing the plugin, or pass playOnInit: false and gate the initial .play() call).
